content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_8_lvl1-template_search-2) to the molecule given in make_8_lvl1-apply_template-1 input. That input gave a list of two SMILES: ["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1", "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F"].

So the target molecule is presumably a product of a reaction? Actually the template is from template_id 2895. We need to apply that template to the molecule (the product) to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles = ??? Wait apply_template expects target molecule SMILES and template_id. The target is the product. The product is likely the combined product of the two reactants? The answer from template_search-2 gave mapped_rxn: a reaction SMILES with product on right side (>>). The product side is after >>: [CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1

That product SMILES corresponds to the first SMILES in the list? Let's check: first SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1. That is a tert-butyl carbamate attached to a piperazine? Actually looks like a protected amine. The product SMILES in mapped_rxn is a more complex: includes t-butyl ester? Wait product includes [CH3][C]([CH3])([CH3])O... that's t-butyl ester of something. Yes matches first SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(...). So product is that. The second SMILES O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F is likely a sulfonyl chloride reagent? But the product side only includes the first SMILES; the second is a reagent maybe not part of product. Actually the reaction is a sulfonylation? The template likely is a sulfonylation of an amine with sulfonyl chloride. The product is the sulfonamide? Wait product SMILES includes N attached to something? The product includes N attached to aromatic ring with NH2? Actually product includes [c:14]([NH2:15])... So product includes an aniline with NH2. The sulfonyl chloride would attach to amine to form sulfonamide, but product shows amine not sulfonyl. Hmm.

Nevertheless, we need to apply template 2895 to the molecule(s) given. The target molecule is likely the product (first SMILES). Use apply_template with that SMILES and template_id 2895. Let's call tool.
